description: Implementation of the PersistentCommandPool class for Vulkan command buffer management in ANGLE project.

classes.name: PersistentCommandPool
classes.description: Manages a pool of Vulkan primary command buffers for reuse.

methods.name: ~PersistentCommandPool
methods.description: Destructor for PersistentCommandPool, asserts no valid command pool or free buffers.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the command pool with a given queue family index.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Destroys the command pool and frees associated buffers.

methods.name: allocate
methods.description: Allocates a command buffer from the pool.

methods.name: collect
methods.description: Returns a command buffer to the pool for reuse.

methods.name: allocateCommandBuffer
methods.description: Allocates a new primary command buffer and adds it to the pool.
